problem: Web developers need a fast, general-purpose scripting language to build websites. This repo is the source code of the PHP interpreter itself.

stack.backend: C code: the Zend engine, core, extensions and server APIs, built with autoconf and make
stack.deploy: Built from source and installed; distributed as a language runtime under the BSD-3-Clause license

whatsNew: It is the reference implementation of PHP, with the Zend engine at its core and many extensions that can be added. It has a large test suite run with its own test tool.
